templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum to a Common Paper agreement governing a provider's AI services, including use of customer input and AI-generated output, and restrictions on training with customer data.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: HIPAA Business Associate Agreement setting out how a provider may use, disclose, and safeguard protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, covering access and use, fees, confidentiality, warranties, liability, and term.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Agreement giving an early design partner access to a pre-release product in exchange for feedback and participation in the provider's design partner program.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Data protection terms governing a provider's processing of customer personal data as processor or subprocessor, including GDPR-style obligations, subprocessors, and international transfers.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
templates.description: Standard terms of a mutual NDA governing how each party may use and must protect confidential information disclosed for a stated purpose.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
templates.description: Cover page for the mutual NDA capturing the deal-specific terms, such as purpose, effective date, MNDA term, confidentiality term, governing law, and signatures.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for business partnerships where each party performs agreed obligations, covering fees and payment, a mutual trademark license, escalation procedures, indemnification, and confidentiality.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Short-term trial or evaluation agreement letting a prospective customer test a product before committing to a full commercial agreement.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for professional services performed under statements of work (SOWs), covering deliverables, fees, intellectual property, warranties, and liability.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Uptime and support response commitments for a cloud service, with service credits and termination rights, designed for use with the Cloud Service Agreement.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for licensing installable (on-premises) software, covering the license grant, restrictions, fees, support, warranties, and liability.
